issues.quote: net income climbed 19.4% to $15.0 billion in fiscal 2023 from $12.6 billion
issues.problem: Actual growth was about 19.2% ($14.997B vs $12.583B), not 19.4%.

issues.quote: $18.6 billion over $96.8 billion gives about 18.3% gross margin rather than 18.2%
issues.problem: Gross profit was $17.7B, not $18.6B. $17.66B/$96.77B is about 18.25%, so the stated 18.2% is correct and this 'discrepancy' comes from a wrong input.

issues.quote: The gap between falling operating income and rising net income points to items below the operating line
issues.problem: Doesn't name the main driver: a one-time tax benefit of about $5.9B from releasing a deferred tax valuation allowance.

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit, margins, operating income, R&D and EPS all match Tesla's FY2023 10-K. Net income growth is wrong (about 19.2%, not 19.4%), and the note's gross margin check uses a wrong $18.6B gross profit figure.
